description: List the valid values for a dimension in a Eurostat dataset, preserving value codes and labels exactly. Use this when eurostat_get_dataset_info returns more values than its sample, or to confirm exact filter codes before querying. Dimension identifiers match exactly first, then case-insensitively; TIME_PERIOD aliases time. For geo, use geo_level to select the NUTS hierarchy (country, nuts1, nuts2, nuts3). To find codes in a long list, pass filter: words its code or label contains. Pages default to 25 values, maximum 1,000; pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page with the same dataset, dimension, geo level and filter. Canonical and alias dimension spellings resume the same list. Pass canvas_id on the first call to also stage every value as a two-column code/label table, regardless of filter or limit. Inspect that table with eurostat_dataframe_describe, then search or join it with eurostat_dataframe_query.

canvas_id.description: Also stage the values on this dataframe canvas as a table with two columns, code and label, holding every value the dimension lists at the geo_level requested (country when it is omitted), whatever filter and limit are. Pass the canvasId a eurostat_download_dataset or eurostat_query_dataset response returned, then search the staged table with SQL or join it to a download on the dimension column (e.g., d.geo = g.code). Only on a call without cursor; omit to return the values inline only: this tool never starts a canvas. Ignored on deployments without a dataframe canvas.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the first page. It resumes after that page's last code and is bound to dataset_code, dimension, geo_level and filter, so send those unchanged. Cannot be combined with canvas_id on a deployment with a dataframe canvas.

dataset_code.description: Dataset code (e.g., "nama_10_gdp", or "DS-045409" for a Comext collection).

dimension.description: Dimension code to retrieve values for (e.g., "unit", "na_item", "geo"). Exact match first, then case-insensitive; TIME_PERIOD aliases time. Use eurostat_get_dataset_info to see available dimensions.

filter.description: Words to find, up to 500 characters: keeps only values whose code and label, joined by a space, contain every whitespace-separated word as a substring — in any order, ignoring case and accents ("palma frankfurt" finds DE_EDDF_ES_LEPA, "zurich" finds Zürich). Punctuation is part of a word, and spellings are not transliterated ("münchen" does not find MUENCHEN). Runs over the whole list at the effective geo_level before paging and keeps Eurostat's order, with no ranking; matchCount counts the matches.

geo_level.description: NUTS hierarchy level filter — applies only when dimension is "geo"; passing it with any other dimension is rejected. Options: "aggregate" (EU/EA codes), "country" (2-letter codes, default), "nuts1" (3-char), "nuts2" (4-char), "nuts3" (5-char).

limit.description: Most values per page, default 25, maximum 1,000. Larger positive integers clamp with a notice when EUROSTAT_CLAMP_LIMITS is enabled. Fixed by the first call: with cursor, the cursor carries that limit and this field is ignored.

name: eurostat_get_dimension_values

canvasId.description: Dataframe canvas the values were staged on — the canvas_id supplied. Omitted when nothing was staged: canvas_id was omitted, this deployment runs without a dataframe canvas, or the dimension lists no values.

dimensionCode.description: The dimension code that was queried.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The dataset code or dimension code does not exist. `no_results`: The dataset has no geo values at the effective geo_level. `conflicting_params`: geo_level was combined with a dimension other than "geo", where it has no effect; or, on a deployment with a dataframe canvas, canvas_id was combined with cursor, which would stage the list again on every page. `invalid_cursor`: The cursor is malformed, was issued for a different dataset_code, dimension, geo_level or filter, or resumes after a code the list no longer holds. `upstream_fault`: Eurostat returned a dataset structure or content constraint this server cannot read — malformed, truncated, not XML, or missing the requested dataset's dataflow — or the structure endpoint answered HTTP 5xx or could not be reached on every retry, which the error marks retryable. `canvas_not_found`: A canvas_id was supplied for staging but is unknown or its lifetime has elapsed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

geoLevel.description: Effective NUTS hierarchy level for the geo value set. Present only for the geo dimension; country is reported when geo_level was omitted.

matchCount.description: Values matching filter across the whole list, before paging. Present only when filter was passed.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Pass it back as cursor with dataset_code, dimension, geo_level and filter unchanged; it resumes after this page's last code. Omitted on the last page.

notice.description: Count-limit clamp disclosure, continuation routes (nextCursor, filter, canvas_id), or an explanation of a filter that matched nothing.

stagedRowCount.description: Rows written to the canvas table. Equals totalCount. Omitted alongside tableName.

tableName.description: Canvas table holding every value as two VARCHAR columns, code and label. Call eurostat_dataframe_describe with canvasId first to confirm it, then join it in eurostat_dataframe_query. Omitted alongside canvasId.

totalCount.description: Number of distinct values the dimension lists, after geoLevel filtering for geo — every one, whatever filter and paging apply.

truncated.description: True when more values follow this page — pass nextCursor as cursor to fetch them. Omitted on the last page.

values.description: This page of dataset-available values, in Eurostat's order — for geo, the subset at geoLevel; with filter, only the matches. A page holds the effective limit (default 25, maximum 1,000), fewer only at the end; truncated and nextCursor are set when more follow.

items.description: A dimension value code and label pair.

code.description: Dimension value code. Use these as filter values in eurostat_query_dataset and eurostat_download_dataset.

title: Get Eurostat Dimension Values
